重返非洲 - 索馬利蘭 EP4 街邊坐著的男人們,面前就是一堆成捆現金,沒有保全、沒有監視器,也沒有人搶! 這些錢主要是索馬利蘭先令(SLSH) 因為貨幣貶值嚴重,一筆小額交易就要拿一大疊鈔票!! 當地人非常倚重信任也非常安全! 因此整個貨幣交易運作在一種「社會默契」與「熟人文化」之中~ 很多旅客來這裡拍照、紀錄,因為這個景象幾乎是全球僅見 😎😎 Return to Africa – Somaliland EP4 Men sit along the street with huge stacks of cash in front of them. no security guards, no cameras, and no one tries to steal it! The money is mainly Somaliland Shillings (SLSH). Due to severe currency depreciation, even a small transaction requires a massive bundle of banknotes! Locals rely heavily on trust, and it’s remarkably safe. The entire money exchange system operates on a kind of “social contract” and “close-knit community culture.” Many travelers come here to take photos and document this, as it’s a sight almost unseen anywhere else in the world. 😎😎 #somaliland #africa #african #africaculture #索馬利蘭 #sololeveling #girlstrip
